risk_note: B2-07g (D10-2017 ②; payout, RV2). Read-only admin endpoints listAdminPayoutBatches / getAdminPayoutBatch (CT-24zzo contract): application/admin-payout-batches-read.ts, infra/admin-payout-batches-store.ts (Kysely, withSchema app, every statement scoped by app_id, attempts read as kind / result / at only), http/admin/payout-batches-read.controller.ts (payout.execute or fund.view, no step-up, unknown / foreign / non-UUID batch_id → 20001 [batch_id]), payout.module.ts registers it on the admin entry only. next_query_at reuses query-schedule.ts (nextQueryPoint / nextQueryDueMs) with payout.query_schedule read as the query job does, injected Clock, independent of payout.queue_paused / payout.enabled (BR-WDR-17); has_transfer_attempt counts a kind=transfer attempt of any result; ties by id in SQL; no writes, no audit. contracts/openapi.yaml drops x-implementation: planned on the two operations only; planned-operations.gen.ts and route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated.

reviews.note: Fresh independent Claude via claude-run.sh; pass, validate ok, positions unchanged (couli-runs/B2-07g/review-money-r1.json).
